violations.reason: The agent modified reservation 43TOIE from HAT087 CLT→LGA to HAT015 CLT→EWR, changing the destination from LGA to EWR. The policy permits modifying non-basic-economy reservations only when origin, destination, and trip type remain unchanged, so the agent should have denied the requested destination change instead of executing update_reservation_flights.
